ICE @ ECC 2027

Interactions, Control and Events

This one-day workshop brings together Rodolphe’s former doctoral students and postdoctoral researchers to discuss new directions in systems and control, and to celebrate his 60th birthday. The programme follows the successive generations of his research community.

UCLouvain–Woluwé campus. The announced conference campus. The birthday workshop room will be announced following confirmation.

Registration information will be added after workshop acceptance and publication of the conference registration arrangements.
Travel
The planned setting is the ECC 2027 conference campus in Brussels. Venue access and local travel details will be added once the workshop room is confirmed.
Lunch & dinner
Lunch is included in the draft timetable. Catering, dinner venue and any charges are to be confirmed.
